exposure: fetal fraction (FF) levels in cell-free fetal DNA (cffDNA)
low fetal fraction (LFF) (< 4% and < 5th percentile/3.6% cut-off values)
cohort: The study included 2063 pregnant women with normal 1st and 2nd trimester non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT) results between 2016 and 2021.
finding: Low fetal fraction (LFF) in pregnant women with normal NIPT results was significantly associated with a higher incidence of pregnancy-induced hypertensive diseases (PIHD) and composite adverse maternal outcomes.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (LBW), macrosomia (as measured outcomes)
gest_age: Small for gestational age (SGA), large for gestational age (LGA) (as measured outcomes); gestational age at NIPT was adjusted for.
